vnodes.title: Lean checkers disagree on adversarial exports: lean4lean, con-leche and con-ron rejected the #15908 non-canonical Nat.add exploit that the Lean paranoid kernel and leanchecker --from-export accepted; maintainers count False only under the standard prelude
vnodes.summary: lean4 issue #15908 (2026-10-24, closed): an export redefining a prelude declaration proves False with no axioms; accepted by the default/paranoid kernel and leanchecker, rejected by three independent checkers. Maintainers define alternative preludes as adversarial input, not a soundness bug, and ask that soundness reports go privately to security@lean-fro.org. So "all 6 accept" is evidence only for our own prelude; checker diversity catches real disagreements; vendor threat model = standard prelude only.

vnodes.title: native_decide proofs cannot be re-checked by lean4checker or comparator (ValidatingProofs 4.35): ban it outright, not just allowlist around it
vnodes.summary: The Lean 4.35 ValidatingProofs page states that external checkers cannot check proofs using native evaluation; per-computation axioms (since 4.29) mark them. A native_decide proof therefore removes the multi-checker defence entirely; the golden gate bans native_decide/bv_decide and treats any _native axiom as FAIL.

vnodes.title: lake check (PR #14990, merged 2026-09-07) needs lake-manifest.json and the kernel accepts sorryAx: only the axiom audit catches a sorry
vnodes.summary: PR #14990 adds lake check (build default targets, export, kernel replay, fail on axioms beyond the standard three) and requires a manifest. Because the kernel accepts sorryAx, the CI gate must keep a separate sorry/axiom check and commit an (empty) lake-manifest.json.

vnodes.title: 2026 Lean kernel exploits need adversarial metaprograms or malicious Lake dependencies (local, build-time, CVSS AV:L/UI:R) and #15241 needs >=18 GB RAM: the proof threat is the proof-build supply chain
vnodes.summary: #14484/#14576 were found on 4.34.0-nightly via live.lean-lang.org and adversarial metaprograms; the oss-security 2026-08-02 advisory (fix first in nightly-2026-07-29) requires a malicious metaprogram plus a hash collision; PR #15241 use-after-free matters only with >=18 GB free RAM and did not affect nanoda/con-ron. Golden: no third-party Lean deps or metaprograms in the proof build, hash-pinned toolchain, sandboxed no-network build.

vnodes.title: Second independent pgsql-hackers report (2026-10-06) with a patch swapping ON CONFLICT WHERE and RLS check order (ExecOnConflictUpdate/Select); PG19 DO SELECT view exposure called a release open item
vnodes.summary: Joao Detomini reported the WHERE-before-RLS order in both ExecOnConflictUpdate and ExecOnConflictSelect with a patch; the Holmberg thread (2026-09-25) says PG18 and probably older are affected; Kirill Reshke called the DO SELECT security_barrier view exposure a regression that should be an open item before PG19 release. No committed fix seen as of the verifier pass: re-check at synthesis; PG19 adoption gated on it.

vnodes.title: CVE-2017-15099: INSERT ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE did not check SELECT policies (fixed 10.1 / 9.6.6 / 9.5.10): direct precedent for the 2026 ON CONFLICT WHERE-before-RLS class
vnodes.summary: Historical precedent that the ON CONFLICT path is a repeat RLS bug site; supports the denylist rule that upsert WHERE carries no user expressions and that the write oracle includes ON CONFLICT variants on every engine bump.

vnodes.title: Redis ACL doc: key permissions ignore side channels (LPUSH/STRLEN/TYPE metadata), FLUSHALL/FLUSHDB/SWAPDB need explicit -flushall -flushdb -swapdb, and RediSearch indexes require key-prefix superset access
vnodes.summary: Confirms the explorer SCAN/metadata leak finding is documented behaviour, gives the exact remediation string, and adds a new hazard: search indexes need prefix-superset access, so a per-tenant ACL user cannot use a shared index; any search-module use needs per-tenant indexes or stays out of the golden.

vnodes.title: The cmvp lock (rustls 0.23.43) carries RUSTSEC-2026-0349 (patched >=0.23.46): unauthenticated ServerHello can poison later client handshakes to classical KX
vnodes.summary: RUSTSEC-2026-0349 is client-side PQ downgrade via key-share prediction; the cmvp profile cannot take the fix without leaving the CMVP-listed module. Mitigation for a listener-only server: server pq-required kx_groups + frozen HRR verdicts, and no rustls client use in the cmvp build (or a declared exception).

vnodes.title: rustls 0.24.0-dev.0/1/2 (2026-01-28 / 07-23 / 10-14) exist; aws-lc-rs 1.17.4 needs fips-sys ^0.13.17; 1.15.4 (2026-01-23) unyanked; fips-sys 0.13.17 exists; MIP lists dynamic+static AWS-LC 4 and 5
vnodes.summary: Reversal triggers for the two-lock decision must include a rustls 0.24 release (may change the aws-lc-rs bound) and the AWS-LC 5 cert (Pending Review 2026-10-05), not only AWS-LC 4. The CMVP certificate names the dynamic module; static (bcm.o) applicability to a Rust-linked build is a separate gate.

vnodes.title: Pingora CVE-2026-105298 also covered userinfo in the authority (user@host), fixed in 0.9.0 with 400; grpc-go CVE-2026-33186 was fixed by rejecting, not repairing, a :path without leading slash
vnodes.summary: Two reject-not-repair precedents for CANON-2/CANON-6: reject "@" in :authority/Host, reject non-origin-form :path with codes.Unimplemented. grpc-go exploitability needs deny rules plus a fallback allow.

vnodes.title: WHATWG PR #914 admits Bidi-rule-violating hosts (e.g. 2.xn--mgbb) and a Deno rust-url fork already passes all-ASCII xn-- through: ecosystem divergence, a measurable client-compatibility cost for exact-match ingress
vnodes.summary: Browsers will send hosts the golden exact-match ingress rejects; quantify with the false-reject spike before freezing CANON-2 for hosts.

vnodes.title: Official MCP conformance suite gaps: #553 grades -32020 header/body mismatch as WARNING though 2026-07-28 makes it MUST (a -32600 server passes 9/9 with 5 warnings); #570 leaves SEP-2243 rows untested
vnodes.summary: Conformance "pass" is not evidence of listener-gate correctness; the AEGIS corpus keeps -32020 strictness and SEP-2243 cases of its own and treats suite warnings as failures.

vnodes.title: Default-off DNS-rebinding protection is a cross-SDK CVE class in 2026: mcp-toolbox CVE-2026-11624 (allowed-hosts *), Java SDK CVE-2026-35568, Ruby SDK CVE-2026-63118; agentgateway kept it opt-in by policy (#1855, PR 3022)
vnodes.summary: External corroboration of the defaults matrix; the spec (2026-07-28 security best practices) says servers SHOULD bind handles server-side to the authenticated user and MUST NOT accept tokens not issued for them, backing the audiences-unset and passthrough findings. Golden: listener gate on by construction.

vnodes.title: Wasmtime host panics map to the native-abort blast row only on Rust >=1.81 (GHSA-q8hx abort; UB before); GHSA-6wgr pooling leak is Low (CVSS4 2.3), weak support for state-leak severity
vnodes.summary: Split guest-triggerable host bugs into abort vs panic: with panic=unwind + catch_unwind some are contained. The golden uses panic=abort for size, so the mapping holds for the golden but must be stated as toolchain-dependent.

vnodes.title: CVE-2026-42945 (NGINX Rift) needs a non-default rewrite config (unnamed PCRE capture + "?" in replacement) and an ASLR bypass for RCE: limited exposure, not indifference, explains the absent switching
vnodes.summary: Qualifies econ.security-incident-no-switch: the no-switch result is confounded by conditional exploitability; the thread also had switching-interest comments (memory-safe alternative asks).

vnodes.title: Hybrid X25519MLKEM768 already ships on by default (OpenSSL 3.5, Go, Cloudflare/GCP LBs), so PQ absence from forum criteria means table stakes ("must work silently"), not no demand
vnodes.summary: Confounder for econ.differentiators-absent. Origin-side adoption figures (~3.7%) are secondary and unverified.

vnodes.title: Forced ingress-nginx migration is steered by distribution maintainers (RKE2 makes Traefik the default), so distribution channel, not buyer criteria, gates that segment
vnodes.summary: Adds a channel factor to the who-switches-first hypothesis: getting into distro defaults (k3s/RKE2/Helm charts) matters more than feature lists for the forced-migration segment.

vnodes.title: PikeOS Separation Kernel 5.1.3 holds BSI-DSZ-CC-1146-2022 at EAL5+ (4.2.4 was EAL3+); PikeOS EAL7 appears only in a ~2011 in-progress press release
vnodes.summary: The realistic commercial separation-kernel CC ceiling observed is EAL5+; supports the buyer route of EAL4+/formal policy model rather than EAL7.

vnodes.title: The 7-day cooldown lock (re-executed 2026-10-25) holds rustls-webpki 0.103.15, the version vulnerable to RUSTSEC-2026-0382 (distrusted emSign intermediates): the cooldown ships a known advisory until the expedite path fires
vnodes.summary: Confirms the audited security-advisory bypass is mandatory, not optional: CI must fail when the cooldown-resolved lock intersects an advisory with a published patched version, and route that crate through the bypass.
